title: San Martin Bakery
description: A comprehensive food delivery and management system consisting of Backend API (NestJS), Customer App (React Native), and Admin Panel (Next.js). The platform supports bakery chains with delivery logistics, inventory management, and customer ordering capabilities.

title: San Martin Bakery API
description: A comprehensive food delivery and management system consisting of Backend API (NestJS), Customer App (React Native), and Admin Panel (Next.js). Key features include multi-store bakery management, geofenced delivery zones, order processing, catalog parsing, and real-time notifications. The platform supports bakery chains with delivery logistics, inventory management, and customer ordering capabilities.
